tokenHintHtml: Needed for private repos (api.github.com does not receive github.com session cookies) and for a higher rate limit. A fine-grained token with "Pull requests: Read-only" permission is enough. Create token ↗
tokenTestNoToken: No token set — public repos only, limit 60/h{quota}
confirmReset: Reset all branch colors to their defaults? This cannot be undone.
defaultRowTitle: Fallback color for all unconfigured branches
namePatternHint: Exact branch name, or a pattern with * as a wildcard (e.g. "release/*" matches "release/1.0"). An exact match always wins; among several matching patterns, the topmost one wins — drag rows to reorder.
dragHandleTitle: Drag to reorder (higher = wins ties between matching patterns)
clearDiscoveredConfirm: Clear all discovered branch names? They will reappear as PRs are re-scanned.
repoContextTemplateLabel: No active GitHub repo tab detected — editing the default template used for new repos
scanBranchesTitle: Looks at recent PRs (open and closed) and suggests only the branches they actually target — not every git branch in the repo
scanBranchesDoneTruncated: ✓ Found {count}+ target branch(es) (stopped at the page limit)
